name: ymodecs
description: ECS_ymod is a small lightweight ECS engine used to implement a very basic 2D game using SDL graphics libs. This project supports LUA scripting and USD for world description: the wrappers need to be completed/optimized but they are still able to read a USD file or a LUA script. Right now the output is a small Star chicken able to shoot projectiles against UFO enemies (very basic) with keyboard and mouse support. I also added sprite collisions and I started to implement projectile logic (not completed yet).
